references.title: SOFA Time Scale and Calendar Tools
references.use: UTC, TAI and TT are distinct time scales; UTC leap seconds require explicit handling.

references.title: Terrestrial Time (TT)
references.use: TT = TAI + 32.184 seconds exactly; J2000 TT/TAI/UTC epoch reference.

references.title: Bulletin C 72
references.use: No leap second at end of December 2026; UTC-TAI remains -37 seconds from 2017-01-01 until further notice.
